$comment: 2024 (and 2020) presidential vote shares per congressional district. Used for imputing the two-party split in uncontested 2024 House races. Percentages are of total votes cast in that district; sums to slightly less than 100 because third-party + write-ins are excluded.
source: The Downballot — 'The Downballot's calculations of presidential election results by congressional district.'
